sentences.span: The 10-year yield broke 4.40% on Friday for the first time since May.
sentences.why: Exact match of level, day, and recency claim.

sentences.span: We think the move is a bear-steepener: the front end is anchored by a Fed on hold
sentences.why: Note is JPMorgan's own ('We'), so attributing the bear-steepener read and the anchoring mechanism to JPMorgan is correct.

sentences.span: We recommend paying 5s30s at 62bp with a stop at 48bp. Citi's rates desk, by contrast, sees the break as a positioning flush and expects 4.40% to hold on a closing basis.
sentences.why: The pay 5s30s @62bp/stop 48bp trade is JPMorgan's own call ('We recommend'). Citi is cited only for a contrasting view that 4.40% holds — Citi never calls this trade. Attribution swapped from JPMorgan to Citi.

sentences.span: (no matching content — source contains no Goldman view, no 4.75% target, no foreign-demand claim)
sentences.why: Goldman is not mentioned anywhere in the source; the 4.75% year-end target and foreign-demand-fading rationale have no basis in this document.

sentences.span: A hot core PCE print on Thursday (consensus 0.3% m/m) would validate our steepener
sentences.why: Thursday timing, 0.3% m/m consensus, and the framing as the test/validator for the steepener trade all match.
